brand_notes: Performa3 M106 (6.5", 8 Ω nominal) current on Revel US; ~$1,100 each at Audio Advice. Three measurement rigs agree: sensitivity 85.4-86.4 dB vs 87 claimed; min impedance 4.3-4.6 Ω. Stereophile notes a vertical crossover suckout (tall stands). Sources: asr-revel-m106, soundstage-nrc-revel-m106, stereophile-revel-m106.
takeaways: Three rigs (ASR Klippel, NRC anechoic, Stereophile MLSSA) agree: flat, clean; LW ±1.7 dB, f3 59 Hz.
Sensitivity 85.4-86.4 dB measured vs 87 dB claimed.
Impedance min ~4.3-4.6 Ω: below-iec but above 4 Ω.
Distortion near zero above 1 kHz; ~2.5% at 100 Hz at 86 dB.
Stereophile flags a vertical suckout at crossover: use tall stands.
